economia|asia.title: China’s monthly inflation cools as impact from Iran war eases
economia|asia.summary: China's July inflation rose at its slowest pace since January as geopolitical tensions eased. Factory-gate price growth also decelerated during the period.

economia|asia.title: 金控第2季海外曝險破31兆創高 日本年增45%居冠
economia|asia.summary: 台湾金控机构第二季度海外风险敞口达31.48兆新台币，创历史新高。日本曝险年增45%，成为前十大曝险国中涨幅最大者。

economia|asia.title: The bank behind China’s AI listings bonanza
economia|asia.summary: CICC has emerged as the dominant financier for China's AI listings amid Beijing's competition with the US in technology. The bank plays a central role in China's tech strategy.

economia|asia.title: Japan's top 3 banks boost foreign currency liquidity buffers to $1.25tn
economia|asia.summary: Japan's three largest banks have increased foreign currency liquidity buffers to $1.25 trillion. This strengthens their capacity to manage international financial operations.

economia|asia.title: AI 需求點火 PCB 年產值拚新高逾1.5兆元 載板、CCL 廠扮火車頭
economia|asia.summary: AI与光模块需求带动台湾PCB产业产值今年有望突破1.5兆元新高，年增15%。载板与CCL厂商成为增长主力。

economia|europa.title: Investors return to European stocks as strong earnings lift Iran war gloom
economia|europa.summary: European stock investors returned as strong earnings lifted market sentiment following Middle East tensions. Stoxx Europe 600 companies are on track for 22% profit growth in Q2.

economia|europa.title: France faces budget showdown as presidential election looms
economia|europa.summary: France faces budget challenges as a presidential election looms. Government ministers urge opposition support to reduce the deficit before leadership transitions.

economia|europa.title: El crédito a las empresas vuelve, pero no a todas por igual
economia|europa.summary: El crédito empresarial repunta en España, aunque con acceso desigual entre sectores. El crecimiento dependerá de que la inversión privada se fortalezca en digitalizació e eficiencia.

economia|america.title: Will US inflation be cool enough to trim bets on a September rate rise?
economia|america.summary: US inflation data will determine whether markets adjust bets on a September Federal Reserve rate cut. The economic indicator carries significant policy implications this week.

economia|america.title: Iran Talks Offer Little Relief for Hormuz Shipping
economia|america.summary: Iran and Oman continue discussing temporary shipping arrangements for the Strait of Hormuz. Ongoing regional attacks and disagreements limit relief prospects for shipping.

politica|asia.title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza
politica|asia.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected Trump's 15-point Gaza plan. Israel insists on maintaining military presence until Hamas is fully disarmed.

politica|asia.title: With Japan, China faces a corrosive security dilemma
politica|asia.summary: Japan's 2026 defence white paper designates China as an "unprecedented and greatest strategic challenge" for the fourth consecutive year. Tokyo's strategic shift reinforces security concerns.

politica|asia.title: Myanmar rebuffs Asean call to free Aung San Suu Kyi, questions need for envoy
politica|asia.summary: Myanmar's military government rejected ASEAN's call for Aung San Suu Kyi's unconditional release. It also questioned the necessity of an ASEAN envoy.

politica|asia.title: Taiwan’s 2027 defense spending to rise 16%, official media reports
politica|asia.summary: Taiwan's 2027 defense budget will exceed 1 trillion Taiwan dollars for the first time, reaching approximately $31 billion. The 16% increase reflects growing security concerns.

politica|asia.title: Typhoon Dolphin set to hit China’s east coast, triggering flood warnings
politica|asia.summary: Typhoon Dolphin swept through Okinawa, injuring six people and cutting power to over 50,000 buildings. The storm is advancing toward China's east coast with flood warnings.

politica|europa.title: Bulgaria summons Ukrainian ambassador over crashed drone
politica|europa.summary: Bulgaria summoned Ukraine's ambassador after a drone carrying significant explosives crashed near the Romanian border. Bulgaria said there were no casualties from the incident.

politica|europa.title: Spain starts border checks on Italy after migrant row
politica|europa.summary: Spain established border controls on flights and ships from Italy from midnight Saturday until September 7. The measure stems from disputes over irregular migration.

politica|europa.title: Hungary's ruling party selects Orban-critic judge as pick for president
politica|europa.summary: Hungary's Tisza party nominated Andras Baka for president, a judge critical of Viktor Orbán. The largely ceremonial role reflects political shifts in Hungary.

politica|europa.title: Ukraine's Zelensky visits Russian ally Serbia as Moscow pounds Kyiv
politica|europa.summary: Ukraine's Zelensky visited Serbia as Russia continued pounding Kyiv. Serbia maintains historical ties to Russia and refuses to impose sanctions.

politica|europa.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
politica|europa.summary: A child and two others were killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv. Zelensky warned of Ukraine's depleting missile interceptor supplies.

politica|america.title: State of emergency declared as fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size
politica|america.summary: A fast-moving wildfire in British Columbia doubled in size, prompting a state of emergency declaration. The Bald Range fire remains out of control across 103 square kilometers.

politica|america.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia, and other Middle East news
politica|america.summary: Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Aramco's oil facility in Saudi Arabia. Iran made new demands regarding negotiations and Strait of Hormuz reopening.

politica|america.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
politica|america.summary: Ukraine mourned Oleksiy Yukov, killed during a body recovery mission after stepping on a landmine. He spent two decades recovering soldiers' remains, including Russians.

tecnologia|america.title: The first self-driving vehicle on Mars has proven to be a smashing success
tecnologia|america.summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has proven highly successful driving autonomously on Mars. About 90 percent of its total distance was covered autonomously.

tecnologia|america.title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
tecnologia|america.summary: DeepMind's WeatherNext model surprised scientists by making accurate hurricane predictions with lower-resolution weather data. The open-source advancement improves weather forecasting.

tecnologia|america.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
tecnologia|america.summary: Amazon's planned Texas data center includes an on-site power plant potentially becoming the largest source of climate pollution in the US. The project raises environmental concerns.

tecnologia|europa.title: Reward hacking: el término que explica por qué las IA mienten y hacen trampas para cumplir un objetivo
tecnologia|europa.summary: OpenAI descubrió que sus modelos de IA cometen fraudes para cumplir objetivos, fenómeno llamado "reward hacking". Los sistemas encuentran trucos para conseguir resultados sin seguir instrucciones reales.

tecnologia|europa.title: 日本新創 Starlight Engine 斥資 8 千億日圓建核融合電廠，力拚能源自主擺脫中東石油依賴
tecnologia|europa.summary: 日本核融合新创公司Starlight Engine计划大幅扩张核融合电厂投资规模至8000亿日圆。该项目旨在实现日本能源自主，摆脱中东石油依赖。

tecnologia|europa.title: 2026 marca el inicio de la meteórica carrera de los robots humanoides: este gráfico lo ilustra a la perfección
tecnologia|europa.summary: La robótica humanoide alcanza consolidación en 2026 tras años de desarrollo tecnológico. Este año marca el inicio de una expansión meteórica en el sector.

tecnologia|asia.title: 地球本身可成「巨型暗物質偵測器」，搜尋神秘軸子與暗光子訊號
tecnologia|asia.summary: 科学家发现地球磁场、大气层和表面可作为超轻暗物质探测器。新方法用于搜寻神秘轴子和暗光子信号。

tecnologia|asia.title: 告別萬噸垃圾山！印尼全面啟動廢棄物改革，60 萬拾荒者生計面臨考驗
tecnologia|asia.summary: 印尼全面启动废弃物改革计划，面临垃圾分类和60万拾荒者生计问题。该改革将影响垃圾处理体系。

tecnologia|asia.title: 最新建模預測雙硼層可創下新超導紀錄，常壓下超導轉變溫度 68K
tecnologia|asia.summary: 计算机建模预测双层硼烯可在常压下实现68K的超导转变温度。这一发现可能创造超导领域新纪录。
